brisk.label: Brisk
brisk.description: Fast-talking, quick cutting, overlapping dialogue — screen time runs shorter than the page.

standard.label: Standard
standard.description: One page ≈ one minute. Right for most scripts.

measured.label: Measured
measured.description: Slow-burn or contemplative — long silences, lingering images, held moments that play longer than they read.

pdfFonts.missing: The {{fonts}} font could not be loaded, so that text is blank in the PDF.
pdfFonts.unsupported: {{scripts}} cannot be written to a PDF yet, so that text is missing or garbled. The rest of the script exported normally.

Agreement.label: Subject–verb agreement
Agreement.description: Verb form must match the subject ("she walk" → "she walks").

Grammar.label: Grammar
Grammar.description: Tense, confusables (their/they're), pronoun case, and similar mistakes.

Capitalization.label: Capitalization
Capitalization.description: Proper nouns, sentence starts, the pronoun "I".

Punctuation.label: Punctuation
Punctuation.description: Missing commas, stray spaces around punctuation.

WordChoice.label: Word choice
WordChoice.description: Suggests a clearer or more idiomatic word.

Spelling.label: Spelling
Spelling.description: Misspelled words (overlaps with the spell checker — disable one).

Enhancement.label: Enhancement
Enhancement.description: Optional rewrites that often improve clarity.

Regionalism.label: Regionalism
Regionalism.description: Word usage that is unusual outside a particular region.

Miscellaneous.label: Other
Miscellaneous.description: Other grammar issues that don't fit the categories above.

scenes.label: Scene Report
scenes.description: Every scene with its location, length, screen time and who speaks

characters.label: Character Report
characters.description: Speeches, words and scenes for every speaking character

locations.label: Location Report
locations.description: Each location, how often it is used and for how many pages

cast.label: Cast Report
cast.description: Character profiles with role, gender, age and speaking scenes

breakdown.label: Breakdown Report
breakdown.description: Tagged props, costumes, vehicles and more, with their scenes

notes.label: Notes Report
notes.description: Every note with its replies, who wrote it, who it is assigned to, and whether it is resolved
notes.title: Notes Report

openNotes.label: Open Notes
openNotes.description: Only the notes not yet resolved, with their replies — what is still to do
openNotes.title: Open Notes
